description: 8/30 - The Onyx Downtown is proud to present Growing Pains, a new series focused on highlighting some of the most powerful and profound coming-of-age films ever made. Best friends Yuta and Kou are about to graduate high school in a near-future Tokyo where the threat of a catastrophic earthquake pervades daily life. One night, they pull a consequential prank on their principal, which leads to a surveillance system being installed in the school. Between the oppressive security system and a darkening national political situation, Kou feels increasingly frustrated with the world while Yuta seems completely unaware. Finding an empathetic ear in a passionate student activist, Kou’s political consciousness blossoms. Assuming that Yuta would never understand his newfound interests, Kou begins to avoid his friend. For the first time in their lifelong friendship, the two are forced to confront differences that they never had expressed before. IN JAPANESE W/ ENGLISH SUBTITLES

title: AKI KUMAR & MANIC MOJO at the Wild Eye Pub
description: On Saturday, Sept 5th from 6:30 - 9:30pm the Wild Eye Pub in Grass Valley invites music lovers to their creekside stage for a live performance featuring AKI KUMAR & MANIC MOJO!, The show opens at 6:30pm with MANIC MOJO - an exciting new all originals band emerging in the Nevada County music scene! MANIC MOJO is born of the raw talent and musical synergy of its two core members, Manny Servantes and Nico Paoletti, both born and raised in Nevada County, whose shared passion for creating original music is the driving force of their unique, one of a kind sound. They are multi instrumentalist, singer songwriters and arrangers, blending influences of blues, soul, jazz, funk and rock through powerful, dynamic instrumentation and vocals. MANIC MOJO features Manny Servantes on harmonica, Nico Paoletti on guitar and vocals, Gregory S. Young on keys, Will Madrid on Bass and David Clouse on drums. Their line up of unforgettable original songs combines energetic hooks, licks and lyrics with irresistible dance grooves for a sound that is truly their own., Headlining for this event is Bay Area harmonica player and vocalist, AKI KUMAR, an Indian-born musician known for his eclectic sound, blending a deep love for American, Chicago style blues with classical melodies from his Indian heritage. A masterful harmonica player, soulful vocalist, band-leader, drummer and producer, Kumar is a man of many talents who's become well known as a prolific artist of the Sa Francisco Bay Area. His blending of retro Indian music into his presentations makes for a unique, electrifying, multi-cultural mash-up with a sound like no one else, yet his music never loses touch with the inspirational foundation it draws from the blues.

title: Omari Tau & Friends: A Portrait of America in Song
description: Baritone Omari Tau performs a genre-spanning (jazzy classical) program that is quintessentially American — spanning Kurt Weill, Fats Waller and George Gershwin, alongside new American composers and selections from Tau's own new album, Safe Thus Far. He is joined by pianist Graham Sobelman, a Sacramento-based music director whose credits include Broadway Sacramento and B Street Theatre, and cellist Natalie Hagwood of the genre-crossing ensemble Solabel., Tau is a longtime presence in the Music in the Mountains community. He has performed with the organization's community engagement programs and holiday concerts, and served as co-founding artistic director of MIM favorite Rogue Music Project. title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari with Live Score by the Invincible Czars
description: 9/6 - The Onyx Downtown and The Nevada City Film Festival are excited to announce the newest collaborative screening with legendary rock band The Invincible Czars, as they perform live musical accompaniment for THE CABINET OF DR. CALIGARI! The world’s first feature-length horror film THE CABINET OF DR. CALIGARI tells the story of a group of friends who encounter the mysterious doctor and his scary, sleepwalking sidekick Cesare at a carnival. When a series of murders brings the town to its knees, Franzis sets out to prove Caligari is responsible… but is he? The Invincible Czars perform their nightmarish-ly fun soundtrack along with the film as an immersive live experience, transporting audiences back 100+ years via an age-old tale accompanied by a chilling, tastefully-modern score featuring an impressive blend of traditional acoustic and present-day electric instruments. From delicate passages of longing and love to menacing motifs of dissonant horror and pain, each instrument plays a critical role establishing character themes and creating an aural dreamscape for the film. TICKETS ON SALE NOW! $20 in advance, $25 at the door.

title: Tahoe Music Alive presents Trio Bohémo
description: Get Ready for Trio Bohémo!, Tahoe Music Alive proudly presents Trio Bohémo in concert on September 10 at Olympic Valley Chapel, bringing one of today’s most exciting chamber music ensembles to North Lake Tahoe., Comprised of Matouš Pěruška (violin), Kristina Vocetková (cello), and Jan Vojtek (piano), Trio Bohémo has swiftly emerged as a powerful new voice on the international classical music scene. In just five years, the ensemble has amassed an extraordinary list of accolades, including First Prize and the Audience Prize at the International Joseph Haydn Competition in Vienna, top honors at the International Parkhouse Award in London, and the International Johannes Brahms Competition in Austria. Additional prizes from major competitions in Australia and Germany, along with being named Ensemble of the Year 2021 by Italy’s Le Dimore del Quartetto and receiving a prestigious award from the Czech Chamber Music Society, underscore the trio’s meteoric rise., Trio Bohémo’s artistry has taken them to some of the world’s most respected stages. Recent debuts include the Vienna Musikverein, Wigmore Hall in London, and Stoller Hall in Manchester, as well as appearances at leading festivals such as the Prague Spring Festival, Schwarzwald Musikfestival, and Festival van Vlaanderen in Ghent. The trio has also been featured multiple times on BBC Radio 3’s In Tune, introducing their vibrant sound to audiences across Europe and beyond., In 2024, Trio Bohémo released their debut recording on the Supraphon label, featuring works by Smetana and Schubert. The album was met with exceptional critical acclaim: The Guardian named it “Classical Album of the Week,” praising the performances as “utterly convincing,” while BBC Music Magazine awarded it five stars, calling the Smetana interpretation an “extraordinary standout.” The recording went on to win Debut Album of the Year at the 2024 Presto Music Awards, firmly establishing the trio as a major presence in the recording world.,

Ah Chong (Chow Yun-Fat) is a hitman whose latest job takes a wrong turn when, during a shootout at a lavish nightclub, he accidentally blinds singer Jennie by firing his gun too close to her eyes. Racked with remorse, Ah Chong decides to retire from his life of crime and help Jennie get a cornea transplant. But when Ah Chong's rancorous former boss betrays him, Ah Chong receives an unexpected helping hand from hot-headed police detective Lee Ying (Danny Lee). title: SYRCL's 29th Annual Yuba River Cleanup
description: SYRCL's 29th Annual Yuba River Cleanup spans the entire Yuba River watershed — from the Sierra Nevada headwaters to the lower Yuba — with volunteer shifts at sites throughout the region. Registration is free and open to all ages. After the cleanup, every volunteer is invited to a free appreciation meal and community celebration at Condon Park in Grass Valley beginning at noon., Trash left on the Yuba's banks can be carried by storm water downstream through the watershed, into the Sacramento River, and ultimately into the Pacific Ocean. This year's cleanup is also part of California Coastal Cleanup Day — a statewide effort recognizing that what happens here, on this river, is connected to everything downstream., Last year, 657 volunteers removed over 8,000 pounds of trash and recycling from 25 sites. This year, we are building on that momentum., Event Details, Saturday, September 19, 2026, Cleanup: 9:00 AM – Noon, Appreciation Party: Noon at Condon Park, Grass Valley, Free and open to all ages, Register and find your site: https://yubariver.volunteerlocal.com/volunteer/?id=114666

title: The Creative Labyrinth — Layers of Meaning: An Intentional Collage Journeyp
description: Sundays, September 20 & 27, Noon–3:00 p.m., $160, Discover the art of collage as a meaningful creative practice in this two-part workshop inspired by the principles of Intentional Creativity®., Rather than simply arranging images on a page, you’ll create a layered, mixed-media collage/assemblage that reflects your own story, interests, memories, and aspirations. We’ll begin with a playful “Noticing Basket” experience to help you uncover a personal intention for your collage. From there, you’ll gather images, words, textures, and found materials that resonate with you, learning collage techniques and basic design principles along the way., Between sessions, you’ll have the opportunity to collect photographs, handwritten notes, meaningful papers, and other personal treasures you’d like to incorporate into your artwork, making your finished collage a unique expression of what matters most to you., No previous art experience is necessary. Susan will provide a wide variety of papers, images, and collage materials, along with gentle guidance throughout the process., Participants are encouraged to bring any personal items they’d like to include during the second session., Come explore the creative possibilities of mixed-media collage/assemblage and discover how meaningful it can be to create with intention, curiosity, and imagination., All materials are provided., Ages: Adults + Teens 15+, Participants: Minimum 3 / Maximum 8

title: Hard Boiled
venue_name: The Onyx Downtown at the Nevada Theatre
description: 9/20 - Before breaking into Hollywood, John Woo established himself as a premier international director with a slew of highly influential and beloved action films made in Hong Kong. The Onyx Downtown is thrilled to bring two of his most legendary works from the period to the Nevada Theatre, newly restored in 4K for the first time! Iconic actor Chow Yun-Fat stars as Tequila, a gung-ho cop working to bring down Johnny Wong, the villainous triad boss who maintains a stranglehold on Hong Kong’s illegal gun trade. Johnny attempts to recruit Ah-Long (Tony Leung), an assassin from a rival syndicate, just as the insubordinate Tequila gets taken off the case. Taking justice into his own hands, Tequila tracks Ah-Long down and uncovers an intricate web of deception that threatens to boil over into all-out war. A fiery coalescence of electrifying performances, elaborate narrative and operatic gunfights, HARD BOILED has rightly been exalted as the undisputed champion of Hong Kong action films, ready to unleash a hail of bullets anew in this stunning restoration. IN CANTONESE W/ ENGLISH SUBTITLES

title: Playwriting Group
description: All playwrights welcome! Whether playwriting is new to you or you're already an accomplished playwright, come join this on-going bi-weekly writers' group. We'll spend our time focusing on our writing, but with that magical element of doing so within the presence of others. Come discover the amazing experience of writing within the context of a group. Bring your computer, notebook, iPad, or whatever you like to use for writing. We share resources, discuss our goals and challenges, even provide feedback, but the primary focus of the group is to work on your own play! We'll do a check-in/discussion at the beginning of the meeting, then write in silence, and check-out at the end of our session. Contact Kimberly for the location and to answer any questions you may have. Category: Literary, Theater / Theatre

title: Book release with Caleb Dardick: The Adventures of Superfreak: My Childhood on the Hippie Trail
venue_name: 17894 Tyler Foote Rd, Nevada City, CA (San Juan Ridge)
description: Doors open at 6:30; program starts at 7pm. Books available for sale and book signing. Free event. , Join Nevada County author Caleb Dardick for a hometown launch celebration of his forthcoming memoir, The Adventures of Superfreak: My Childhood on the Hippie Trail (Running Wild Press, September 21, 2026). , The Adventures of Superfreak offers a child’s-eye view of the counterculture—not as nostalgia, but as lived family reality, with all its longing, idealism, danger, and contradiction. In 1970, Caleb’s family set out from Amsterdam to India in a VW bus: three young children traveling with disabled parents—his father using a wheelchair, his mother living with undiagnosed bipolar disorder—on a 20,000-mile journey through Europe, North Africa, the Middle East, Afghanistan, Pakistan, and India. Along the way: psychedelics, free love, tense border crossings, spiritual seekers, and a childhood shaped as much by wonder as by instability., This event is especially meaningful for Caleb as his memoir covers the period leading up to his family’s arrival on the San Juan Ridge in 1973, where he grew up as part of the back-to-the-land movement. Caleb later served as Executive Director of the South Yuba River Citizens League (SYRCL) and then Assistant CEO for the County of Nevada. His father, Sam Dardick, was a Nevada County Supervisor and a disability-rights leader; his parents also co-founded FREED, an independent living center serving people with disabilities., Caleb Dardick is the author of The Adventures of Superfreak: My Childhood on the Hippie Trail. His professional life has spanned public service, nonprofit leadership, environmental advocacy, disability-related community work, and local government. He lives in Nevada City with his wife.

title: Michael Cleveland
venue_name: The Center For The Art - Marissa Funk Theater
description: Weds., September 23, 2026, Doors: 6pm | Show: 7pm, Tickets: Reserved Seating | Genre: Americana, Bluegrass, Roots, Michael Cleveland, widely regarded as the defining bluegrass fiddler of his generation, began performing professionally after high school with Dale Ann Bradley and Rhonda Vincent before forming his own band, Flamekeeper, in 2006—now a seven-time recipient of the IBMA’s Instrumental Group of the Year award. In 2026, he is featured in the Country Music Hall of Fame’s American Currents: State of the Music exhibit, recognizing his ongoing impact on the genre. A twelve-time IBMA Fiddle Player of the Year and 2018 National Fiddlers Hall of Fame inductee, Cleveland has toured and recorded with legendary artists including Béla Fleck, Tommy Emmanuel, Billy Strings, and Vince Gill., He is a four-time GRAMMY® nominee, including a nomination this year for Best Bluegrass Album with Jason Carter for their collaboration Carter & Cleveland, which also won IBMA’s Album of the Year and Song of the Year (“Outrun the Rain”) at this year’s awards. Cleveland previously won a GRAMMY® for Best Bluegrass Album in 2019 for Tall Fiddler, the same year his inspiring journey was chronicled in the documentary Flamekeeper: The Michael Cleveland Story. A recipient of the NEA National Heritage Fellowship, he continues to expand his artistic reach—his masterful fiddle playing can even be heard in the newest season of King of the Hill.

title: Al Di Meola
venue_name: The Center For The Art - Marissa Funk Theater
description: Presented by The Center for the Arts , Fri, September 25, 2026, Doors: 7pm | Show: 8pm, Tickets: Reserved Seating | Genre: Jazz-Rock Fusion, Al Di Meola will bring The Guitarchitect to the Center, pairing acoustic performance with multimedia visuals and personal narrative drawn from Di Meola's five-decade career., Di Meola first rose to prominence as a member of Return to Forever, the ensemble led by Chick Corea, in the mid-1970s. His solo catalog includes landmark recordings such as Elegant Gypsy, Casino, and Splendido Hotel. His acoustic collaboration with Paco de Lucía and John McLaughlin produced Friday Night in San Francisco, one of the best-selling instrumental albums of all time. He is a GRAMMY Award winner, a seven-time recipient of Guitar Player Magazine's Best Guitarist award, and the recipient of both the Miles Davis Lifetime Achievement Award and the BBC Lifetime Achievement Award.

title: Hand-Carved Wooden Utensils--make a spoon
description: Hand-Carved Wooden – Spoons and Spatulas (see tickets for project), 3 hours class – , There’s something deeply satisfying about shaping wood with your own two hands., In this beginner-friendly workshop, you’ll start with a simple block of wood and transform it into a beautiful, functional wooden utensil using traditional hand tools. Under expert guidance, you’ll learn how to safely and confidently use an axe, carving knife, and scoop knife to shape, hollow, and refine your piece., This class is perfect for anyone curious about traditional woodworking or wanting to slow down and experience the rhythm of working with hand tools. No prior experience is necessary — just bring your curiosity and a willingness to learn., By the end of class, you’ll leave with a hand-carved wooden spoon or spatula and the foundational skills to continue carving on your own., What You’ll Create , One hand-carved wooden spoon or spatula (depending on the class ticket you choose), What You’ll Learn, • Safe and proper use of an axe, • Knife carving techniques, • How to use a scoop knife for hollowing, • Foundational greenwood carving skills, Experience Level, Beginners— No experience needed, Ages, Adults, and Teens 13+ may participate when accompanied by an adult., (The accompanying adult may choose to observe or purchase a ticket to participate.), Minimum 5 /Maximum 11 participants, All materials and tools are provided.

title: Woodturning 101 – Craft a Beautiful Wooden Bowl
description: Discover the art of woodturning and learn to make a beautiful wood bowl using a wood lathe – no experience is required!, Are you interested in woodturning and looking to learn a new skill? In this class, you’ll learn how to turn a beautiful bowl out of wood using a lathe. The process is both rewarding and relaxing, as you take a piece of raw wood and turn it into a functional work of wood art. Under the guidance of our experienced instructor, you’ll start by learning the basics of wood lathe operation and safety. Once you’re comfortable with the equipment, we’ll move on to selecting and preparing the wood for turning. With the wood secured on the lathe, you’ll use a series of specially designed tools to shape the bowl. , At the end of the class, you’ll take home a beautiful, hand-turned bowl that you can be proud of. You’ll also have the woodturning skills and knowledge to continue turning bowls on your own. , Price: $160 + $40 materials, Limited spaces available. Sign up today! Class 2 minimum/3 maximum participants – (please note: if attendance does not meet minimum, class will be rescheduled) , Tools provided. If you have tools, please feel free to bring them.

title: Harlan County, U.S.A.
venue_name: The Onyx Downtown at the Nevada Theatre
description: 9/27 - Presented in a new restoration to mark the film’s 50th anniversary, Barbara Kopple’s Academy Award–winning HARLAN COUNTY USA unflinchingly documents a coal miners’ strike in a small Kentucky town. With unprecedented access, Kopple and her crew captured the miners’ sometimes violent struggles with strikebreakers, local police, and company thugs. With a haunting soundtrack—featuring legendary country and bluegrass artists Hazel Dickens, Merle Travis, David Morris, Sarah Ogan Gunning, and Florence Reece—the film is a heartbreaking record of the thirteen-month struggle between a community fighting to survive and a corporation dedicated to the bottom line.

title: Bill Frisell & Harmony Five
description: Presented by The Center for the Arts , Sun. September 27, 2026, Doors: 6pm | Show: 7pm, Tickets: Reserved Seating | Genre: Americana, Folk, Jazz, One of America's most celebrated guitarists and composers, Bill Frisell brings his newly assembled "Harmony Five" ensemble to the Center for the Arts in a concert celebrating his 75th birthday. Frisell's new album In My Dreams (Blue Note Records, 2026) captures the spirit of this rare gathering - a reunion of his closest long-time collaborators, including cellist Hank Roberts, with whom he shares nearly 50 years of musical history., Rounding out the ensemble are vocalist and multi-instrumentalist Petra Haden (daughter of jazz legend Charlie Haden), guitarist/bassist Luke Bergman, and drummer Timothy Angulo - together bringing a remarkable depth of jazz, Americana, and adventurous improvisation to the stage., "A family gathering. A reunion. That's what it feels like getting together with my closest friends. There's still much unfinished business. We're just getting started." - Bill Frisell
